summary: Repair test drift found by the pre-gate tree checks: test_source_bundle sets umask 022 for dpkg-deb, test_storage_packaging follows the current installer package resolution, and the ISO URL and storage repository browser harnesses seed the signed-in marker and expect the current transfer banners. API impact: none — the ISO URL mock now returns a media record, matching the existing contract. tests/test_host_recovery.py restores the process umask after calling recovery.main(), which sets 0077.

guide.reason: Test-only changes; the banners the harness expects already ship and no guide page quotes the old wording.

api.reason: Test harnesses and assertions only; no operation, error or field changed.

state.reason: Tests persist nothing in the product.

verification.method: Test-drift lane: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests (283 then 285 tests OK) and the two browser harnesses against their simulated Controller (exit 0). The umask leak's source is fixed in tests/test_host_recovery.py (in-process umask 0o77 before, 0o22 after; discover run 285 tests OK); the guard in test_source_bundle stays as defense in depth.
